name: io.github.databuddy-analytics/databuddy
title: Databuddy Analytics
description: Web and product analytics: traffic, funnels, errors, Web Vitals, replays, and why a metric moved.

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: List the websites this account can access, with IDs, names, domains, and organizations. Website-scoped tools accept websiteId, websiteName, or websiteDomain.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: List the get_data query types by category, with date presets and a schema summary. Filter by category or contains, with detail='full', for a type's filters, output fields, orderBy columns and time units.

include.description: Sections to include. Default: hints, datePresets, schemaSummary, queryTypeNames. queryTypes adds every type's description.

category.description: Narrow the query catalog to this analytics category.

detail.description: 'summary' returns descriptions only; 'full' adds each type's allowedFilters, outputFields, orderBy columns and timeUnits, and needs category or contains.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Return the analytics tables execute_sql_query can read, with column types and the counting rules for each table.

sections.description: Analytics table sections to inspect; omit or pass [] for all sections.

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Query website analytics: traffic, pages, referrers and UTM campaigns, devices, countries, errors, Web Vitals, sessions, users, custom events, revenue, uptime and AI traffic. Pass a query type from capabilities, or up to 10 as queries; compare adds the previous period. For joins or custom grouping, use execute_sql_query.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

type.description: Breakdown or metric to measure in single-query mode; obtain its query key from capabilities.

from.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start of the measurement period, or an ISO datetime with offset for part of a day; pair with to.

to.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end of the measurement period, or an ISO datetime with offset; pair with from.

timeUnit.description: Size of each time bucket in a time-series result; capabilities with detail='full' lists each type's timeUnits.

limit.description: Breakdowns return 20 rows, or up to 100 per page with limit. Time series return their newest 100 buckets, or up to 1000. For a retention matrix or other complete result, the most rows the whole result may have.

offset.description: Rows to skip in a breakdown; pass the previous result's nextOffset for the next page. Time series do not page.

compare.description: Also measure previous_period (the equal-length range just before) or previous_year (the same dates a year earlier; week buckets compare with the same weekdays 52 weeks earlier). Each row gains previous metrics and change, the percent change (null when previous is 0); rows pair by time bucket and the type's dimensions, such as name or metric_name. orderBy delta.<metric> DESC ranks the biggest movers. from and to must both be dates or both ISO timestamps; with previous_period, week buckets need a range of whole weeks, month buckets whole calendar months, and hour or day buckets over timestamps whole hours or days. Realtime types cannot be compared.

filters.description: Filters as [{field, op, value}]. Ops: eq, ne, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, in, not_in, regex and not_regex (re2 syntax), gt, gte, lt, lte (numeric), is_set and is_not_set (value ignored). field must be one the query type allows: capabilities with detail='full' lists them, and a rejected field returns the allowed list. properties.<key>, such as properties.plan, filters by a custom event or page view property where listed. trait:<key> filters by a profile's current trait with eq, ne, in or not_in only; values compare as strings, so booleans are 'true' or 'false'. Some types take settings as eq filters. breakdown_trait with breakdown_n (1-20) splits usage summary, property metric, property trend and retention results by a trait; it cannot be email, name or username, or be combined with breakdown_property. identified_profile_retention needs activation_event and horizon_days (1, 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90), and takes cohort_granularity (day or week) and activation_properties.<key>. identified_profile_retention_matrix needs activation_event and period_unit (day, week or month), and takes periods, return_mode (on or on_or_after) and activation_basis (first_in_range or first_ever). lifecycle takes event_name (eq, one custom event); with it only path, properties.<key> and trait filters apply. Retention and lifecycle follow identified people only; anonymous visitor IDs change daily, so there is no anonymous visitor retention. account_property cannot be combined with trait filters or breakdown_trait.

field.description: Dimension from capabilities with detail=full, including listed properties.<key> or trait:<key> selectors.

op.description: Comparison applied to the selected analytics dimension.

value.description: Comparison value or membership list; omit for is_set and is_not_set.

orderBy.description: Column to sort by, from the type's orderBy list in capabilities, such as 'visitors' or 'pageviews DESC'. With compare, change.<metric> or delta.<metric> ranks rows by percent or absolute change across both periods, including rows that fell to zero. Rejected values return the allowed list.

queries.description: Batch mode: query items, each with type and optionally its own preset or from/to. Items without a date range use the top-level preset or from/to, and items inherit the top-level timeUnit, limit, filters, and orderBy unless they set their own. Omit 'type' when using this.

type.description: Breakdown or metric query key from capabilities.

preset.description: Measurement period for this query; overrides the top-level date range.

from.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start for this query, or an ISO datetime with offset for part of a day; paired with to, overrides the top-level range.

to.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end for this query, or an ISO datetime with offset; paired with from.

timeUnit.description: Time bucket for this query; otherwise inherits the top-level timeUnit.

limit.description: Breakdowns return 20 rows, or up to 100 per page with limit. Time series return their newest 100 buckets, or up to 1000. For a retention matrix or other complete result, the most rows the whole result may have.

offset.description: Rows to skip in a breakdown; pass the previous result's nextOffset for the next page. Time series do not page.

compare.description: Also measure previous_period (the equal-length range just before) or previous_year (the same dates a year earlier; week buckets compare with the same weekdays 52 weeks earlier). Each row gains previous metrics and change, the percent change (null when previous is 0); rows pair by time bucket and the type's dimensions, such as name or metric_name. orderBy delta.<metric> DESC ranks the biggest movers. from and to must both be dates or both ISO timestamps; with previous_period, week buckets need a range of whole weeks, month buckets whole calendar months, and hour or day buckets over timestamps whole hours or days. Realtime types cannot be compared.

filters.description: Predicates for this query; otherwise inherits the top-level filters.

field.description: Dimension from capabilities with detail=full, including listed properties.<key> or trait:<key> selectors.

op.description: Comparison applied to the selected analytics dimension.

value.description: Comparison value or membership list; omit for is_set and is_not_set.

orderBy.description: Column and optional ASC or DESC, or with compare change.<metric> or delta.<metric>; otherwise inherits the top-level orderBy.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for date presets and date or hour buckets. Defaults to UTC. Row timestamps such as time, first_visit, or last_visit are returned in UTC.

tools.name: execute_sql_query
tools.description: Run read-only ClickHouse SQL on selected websites in one organization. Use get_schema for table notes and include the website column to break results down by site. If you hit the organization limit, try again in a minute.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

websiteIds.description: Website IDs from list_websites. Use this instead of a single website selector.

sql.description: One SELECT or WITH query without comments, comma joins or table functions. Put values in {name:Type} placeholders.

params.description: Values for {name:Type} placeholders. For one site, websiteId and websiteDomain are supplied for you.

tools.name: get_business_context
tools.description: Return the organization's saved business context: what it does, what its events mean, team priorities, success definitions and measurement plans. Read it before judging conversions, activation or success.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: check_tracking
tools.description: Check whether a website's tracking is installed and receiving page views or has stopped, with blocked-request issues, their fix, and the latest coding-agent install report. Use when data looks missing or after installing.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: list_profile_traits
tools.description: List identified-user trait keys such as plan or role, with how many profiles have each and their top values. Use before filtering get_data by trait:<key> or search_replays by user traits.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: search_replays
tools.description: Find recordings by email, profileId, current user traits, recording dates, pages, timeline text, events, activity, or watch score. Use known trait values; ask if unknown. Dates refer to visits. Returns watch links, newest first.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

person.description: Case-insensitive partial match on an identified user's email, name, or profile ID.

emailOrProfileId.description: Exact email or case-sensitive profile ID for an email-shaped search.

email.description: Exact identified-user email, case-insensitive; combine with traits or profileId to narrow it.

profileId.description: The stable profile ID supplied by the site with user identification.

traits.description: Current user traits, all of which must match, such as role=editor or region=eu. These do not describe past trait values.

key.description: Trait key supplied by the site during user identification, such as plan.

value.description: Current trait value to match, expressed as text.

startedAfter.description: Inclusive recording start timestamp with timezone.

startedBefore.description: Exclusive recording start timestamp with timezone.

days.description: Recordings started in the last N days, unless explicit startedAfter/startedBefore bounds are supplied (recordings expire after 30).

category.description: What the visitor was mainly doing, as classified per session.

page.description: Only sessions that visited a path containing this, e.g. /pricing.

text.description: Only sessions whose timeline mentions this (case-insensitive): a clicked button or link label, a typed field, or a page path.

event.description: Only sessions where this custom event fired, e.g. signup_completed. Find event names with the custom_events query.

issue.description: Only sessions with this unanswered-click issue, as `{path}:{element}`: the part after `friction:` in a replay_friction signal key.

withFriction.description: Only sessions with clicks the page never answered.

sessionId.description: One recording by its sessionId (from a replay link's session parameter). Also returns the timeline around each unanswered click.

minWatchScore.description: Only sessions scored at least this worth watching (0-3; 2 = a clear moment of struggle). 0 or unset includes sessions not scored yet.

limit.description: How many recordings to return, newest first.

tools.name: list_replay_issues
tools.description: List the last week's session replay friction: page elements whose clicks got no response (dead, rage or unresponsive clicks), most widespread first. Pass an issue key to search_replays issue to watch them.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Find customer accounts (groups such as workspaces or companies) with plan, billing status, MRR and activity for a period. Pass needsAttention: true for the accounts the team should act on, with why and what to do. Pass search with a company name or domain to find one account, active or not. Use get_account for one account.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

search.description: Text to find in an account's key, name, domain or website, such as a company name or domain. Finds accounts whether or not they were active in the period.

needsAttention.description: Only the accounts the team should act on, the most pressing first, whether or not they were active in the period: failing payments, cancellations, paying accounts gone quiet, trials ending, plan limits. Each comes with attention.

groupType.description: Group type, matching the group_<type> event property, e.g. workspace or company; email_domain groups signed-in users by work email domain. Omit to use the type with the most accounts.

limit.description: Most accounts to return, most active first.

offset.description: Accounts to skip; pass the previous page's nextOffset.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return one customer account: its traits and billing, activity for a period, the identified users active in it, its health and the account reviewer's last review. Keys come from list_accounts.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List metric changes Databuddy detected in the last two days for an organization or website, critical and largest first. Changes already open as investigations are left out; list_investigations has those.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

tools.name: list_insights
tools.description: List published insights for an organization or website: title, summary, evidence, impact, and the recorded next step (null when no step was recorded, when a later finding for the same case superseded it, or when the case resolved).

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: list_investigations
tools.description: List the latest investigation per subject with IDs. state is needs_you, watching or resolved; need says what the team owes. Cases with dashboard work queued or running are left out until it finishes; get_investigation reads one by ID.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: get_investigation
tools.description: Get one durable investigation, including its current status, evidence-backed observations, and replies. A skipped reply ran no work; skipReason says why. The ID may come from Slack or list_investigations.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID from list_investigations, list_insights (investigationId), or Slack.

tools.name: reply_to_investigation
tools.description: Add a clarification to an existing investigation. It is answered from the case's saved evidence, without new measurements or actions. The answer appears in get_investigation. It cannot start a new investigation.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID from list_investigations, list_insights (investigationId), or Slack.

replyId.description: Unique stable idempotency key. Reuse it if this tool call is retried.

tools.name: dismiss_investigation
tools.description: Close an open investigation with the team's reason, only when the user asks. Future investigations read the note. expected, wrong and not_useful keep the subject quiet for 30 days unless it gets materially worse. Preview returns the case and what closing it does; apply with confirmed=true after user approval. No tool reopens it.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID from list_investigations, list_insights (investigationId), or Slack.

reason.description: expected: the team knew or intended it. wrong: the analysis is not right. not_useful: real but not worth attention. already_fixed: fixed outside Databuddy.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_funnels
tools.description: List funnels for a website with their steps and filters. Funnel IDs are used by get_funnel_analytics.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: get_funnel_analytics
tools.description: Return per-step conversion and drop-off for one funnel, by funnelId from list_funnels. Visitors entering in range get conversionWindowHours to finish, even past range end. time_series holds at most the latest 90 points. cohort narrows to matching visitors, and breakdown splits by one current profile trait (top 1-20 values by entrants).

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

cohort.description: Read-only cohort. Funnel filters select first-step visitors; subsequent ordered steps may have different context. Goal filters select page-view visitors and matching completions. Saved filters are ANDed. trait:<key> uses current resolved-user traits with equals/not_equals/in/not_in; requires authenticated website read. Use the referrer breakdown tool to compare source groups. These are visitors, not attempts.

breakdown.description: Break down conversions by one current identified-user trait: {key,n}. Private website read required; caches bypassed.

key.description: Current profile trait key; email/name/username cannot be used.

n.description: Top 1-20 values ranked by distinct entrants; missing and Other are additional buckets.

tools.name: get_funnel_analytics_by_referrer
tools.description: Return one funnel's conversion broken down by referrer, by funnelId from list_funnels. Paginated over referrers. Referrers with a single visitor are omitted, so totals can be lower than get_funnel_analytics.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

These are visitors, not attempts.

A step's filters match properties.<key> on that step's own event. A step's websiteId puts it on another website in the same organization, such as the marketing site before an app signup.

conversionWindowHours.description: Hours a visitor has to finish the funnel after the first step; omitted uses 24 hours. Match the journey's usual length, such as 168 or more for trial-to-paid.

metrics.description: Metric keys displayed in the chart view.

tabId.description: Dashboard tab identifier for the chart view.

yValue.description: Y-axis value to pin the annotation to.

tags.description: Labels such as launch, campaign, or incident.

isPublic.description: true also shows the annotation on the website's public dashboard; false (default) shows it only to organization members.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: update_annotation
tools.description: Update an annotation's text, tags, color, or visibility. Only annotations people added (source databuddy); GitHub markers are read-only. confirmed=false (default) returns the changes without writing; confirmed=true applies them.

tags.description: Replaces the saved tags; omit to keep them, or pass [] to clear them.

isPublic.description: true also shows the annotation on the website's public dashboard; false shows it only to organization members.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: delete_annotation
tools.description: Delete a chart annotation people added (source databuddy) from dashboard charts, including public charts if shared; GitHub markers are read-only. Applying marks it deleted; no restore tool is exposed. Preview returns the annotation.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List short links for the website's organization, newest first, with every folder and its link count. create_link and update_link take those folder IDs or slugs and cannot create folders. search_links finds a specific link.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: search_links
tools.description: Find short links across the full catalog matching a substring on name, slug, target URL, or external ID, newest first.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

query.description: Search query (matches name, slug, URL, or external ID)

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.description: Return click analytics for one short link by ID from list_links or search_links: total clicks, clicks by day, and top referrers, countries and devices for a date range.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a short link in the website's organization. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

slug.description: Path segment of the public short URL; choose a recognizable alias.

expiresAt.description: When redirects expire; a date alone expires at the start of that UTC day.

expiredRedirectUrl.description: Where visitors go after the link expires.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the link, such as a CRM record.

folderId.description: ID of an existing folder from the link folder list. Use null to leave the link unfiled or clear the folder.

folderSlug.description: Existing link folder slug. Use this or folderId, never a display name.

deepLinkApp.description: Native app that opens the link on mobile; targetUrl must belong to it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change a saved short link, affecting subsequent redirects and social previews. Preview returns current, updates, and availableFolders; apply only after user approval.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

slug.description: Path segment of the public short URL; choose a recognizable alias.

expiresAt.description: Expiry date or datetime; null removes the expiry.

anyOf.description: When redirects expire; a date alone expires at the start of that UTC day.

expiredRedirectUrl.description: Where visitors go after the link expires; null clears it.

ogTitle.description: Social preview title; null clears it.

ogDescription.description: Social preview description; null clears it.

ogImageUrl.description: Social preview image URL; null clears it.

externalId.description: Your own ID for the link, such as a CRM record; null clears it.

folderId.description: ID of an existing folder from the link folder list. Use null to leave the link unfiled or clear the folder.

folderSlug.description: Existing link folder slug. Use this or folderId, never a display name.

deepLinkApp.description: Native app that opens the link on mobile; targetUrl must belong to it. null turns it off.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a short link. confirmed=false (default) returns the link without deleting it; confirmed=true deletes it.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_flags
tools.description: List feature flags with their status, rollout, rules, and variants: a website's flags when a website is given, otherwise the organization-wide flags. Flag IDs are used by update_flag and add_users_to_flag.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

status.description: Only return flags with this status.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

tools.name: get_experiment_results
tools.description: Return exposed/converted visitors and comparisons per flag arm for visitors the random split assigned since the split last changed (assignmentChangedAt). Fisher when any expected cell is below 5, else a two-proportion z-test; significance uses Holm-adjusted p-values and minimumVisitorsPerArm. Boolean flags are not randomized and never significant.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

controlArm.description: Arm to compare against. Defaults to a variant named control, then false for boolean and rollout flags, then the first variant.

tools.name: create_flag
tools.description: Create a feature flag, inactive and boolean unless configured. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

key.description: Stable key the application passes to the SDK when evaluating this flag.

type.description: boolean turns on or off, rollout serves a percentage, multivariant serves variants.

status.description: Enabled flags evaluate rules and defaults. Unmet dependencies block evaluation without changing the saved status.

defaultValue.description: Value served when no rule matches.

payload.description: Application configuration returned alongside the flag evaluation.

persistAcrossAuth.description: true keeps a visitor's value after they sign in.

rolloutPercentage.description: Percentage of users included in the rollout.

rolloutBy.description: Identity a rollout percentage buckets by: user (default), organization, team, or group:<type> for the account of that type each user is in, such as group:workspace.

rules.description: Targeting rules by user ID, email, or property.

type.description: Identity attribute to match; property uses field as the attribute name.

operator.description: Comparison against the identity attribute; existence checks do not use comparison values.

field.description: Property name supplied by the application when evaluating flags.

value.description: Single comparison value for non-membership rules when batch is false.

values.description: Comparison set for in or not_in when batch is false.

enabled.description: Result served to users this rule matches: true serves the flag on, false serves it off.

batch.description: Use batchValues as the comparison targets instead of value or values.

batchValues.description: Comparison targets used when batch is true.

valuesTruncated.description: Read-only marker of incomplete targets; use full rules from the update_flag preview instead.

key.description: Stable variant identifier used in experiment results.

value.description: Application value served to users assigned this variant.

weight.description: Percentage allocation assigned to this variant.

description.description: Purpose of this variant for people managing the experiment.

type.description: How the application value should be interpreted.

dependencies.description: Keys of flags that must be enabled, in the same environment, for this flag to evaluate.

environment.description: Environment name, such as production; null serves SDKs that set no environment.

targetGroupIds.description: Existing target-group IDs for this website; obtain them from the dashboard. Replaces attached groups.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: update_flag
tools.description: Change live flag evaluation settings. rules replaces all rules and needs expectedUpdatedAt. Preview returns current with full rules and updates; apply with confirmed=true after user approval.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

type.description: boolean turns on or off, rollout serves a percentage, multivariant serves variants.

status.description: Enabled flags evaluate rules and defaults. Unmet dependencies block evaluation without changing the saved status.

defaultValue.description: Value served when no rule matches.

payload.description: Application configuration returned alongside the flag evaluation.

persistAcrossAuth.description: true keeps a visitor's value after they sign in.

rolloutPercentage.description: Percentage of users included in the rollout.

rolloutBy.description: Identity a rollout percentage buckets by: user (default), organization, team, or group:<type> for the account of that type each user is in, such as group:workspace.

rules.description: Replaces every existing rule. Copy full targets from the confirmed=false preview.

type.description: Identity attribute to match; property uses field as the attribute name.

operator.description: Comparison against the identity attribute; existence checks do not use comparison values.

field.description: Property name supplied by the application when evaluating flags.

value.description: Single comparison value for non-membership rules when batch is false.

values.description: Comparison set for in or not_in when batch is false.

enabled.description: Result served to users this rule matches: true serves the flag on, false serves it off.

batch.description: Use batchValues as the comparison targets instead of value or values.

batchValues.description: Comparison targets used when batch is true.

valuesTruncated.description: Read-only marker of incomplete targets; use full rules from the update_flag preview instead.

key.description: Stable variant identifier used in experiment results.

value.description: Application value served to users assigned this variant.

weight.description: Percentage allocation assigned to this variant.

description.description: Purpose of this variant for people managing the experiment.

type.description: How the application value should be interpreted.

dependencies.description: Keys of flags that must be enabled, in the same environment, for this flag to evaluate.

environment.description: Environment name, such as production; null serves SDKs that set no environment.

targetGroupIds.description: Existing target-group IDs for this website; obtain them from the dashboard. Replaces attached groups.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The flag's updatedAt from the read you based this change on. Required with rules so a newer edit is never overwritten.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: add_users_to_flag
tools.description: Change who receives a flag by targeting site user IDs or emails. Append adds a rule; replace removes all existing rules. Preview first, then apply with confirmed=true after user approval.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

users.description: Identities supplied by your site: emails or stable user IDs, according to matchBy.

matchBy.description: Whether users holds emails (default) or user IDs.

mode.description: append (default) adds one rule; replace deletes every existing rule first.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: delete_flag
tools.description: Archive a feature flag so SDKs stop serving it. Preview returns the flag and any flags that depend on it; apply with confirmed=true after user approval. No restore tool is exposed.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the organization's integrations: Slack workspaces and channels, the GitHub App and each website's repository, Search Console access, and log connections such as Axiom with the datasets each website reads. Includes problems and the page that fixes them.

tools.name: get_log_connection
tools.description: Check a log connection, such as Axiom, with its provider: the datasets its token reads, each website's links and their problems, and suggested links worked out from what each dataset holds, with the evidence. connectionId from list_integrations.

refresh.description: Read the datasets again instead of using suggestions from the last hour.

tools.name: update_log_links
tools.description: Link log datasets to websites so investigations and Databunny read them, or unlink them. Preview shows what each website would read; apply after the user approves. Adding a link a website already has replaces its scope.

add.description: Links to add, such as suggestions from get_log_connection.

websiteId.description: Website ID from list_websites or list_integrations.

scope.description: Read only lines whose field holds one of the values, for a dataset several websites share. Copy it from a suggestion; omit to read every line.

remove.description: Link IDs to unlink, from list_integrations.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: update_log_fields
tools.description: Correct which field of a linked log dataset holds a role, such as the customer's user ID, status code or route, or say no field does; later checks keep the choice. Or have Databuddy check the fields again. linkId and current roles from get_log_connection. Preview first; apply after the user approves.

linkId.description: Link ID from get_log_connection or list_integrations.

role.description: What the field holds: user_id, account_id or email name the customer; status, route, latency, level, message, service, error_type, error_stack, api_key_id, request_id, trace_id and time describe the line.

field.description: The field holding the role, as list_log_sources names it (attributes.user.id), or null when no field does.

recheck.description: Check the link's fields again from its recent lines, such as after the app changed what it logs.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_log_sources
tools.description: List a website's linked backend logs, such as Axiom datasets, with one source's fields (name:type) and what they mean: fieldRoles (the field holding status, route, user_id...) and customerFields (fields matching people or accounts the website knows). Call before query_logs, whose filters use these names.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

sourceId.description: A source id from an earlier list_log_sources call, to list its fields; null for the only one.

match.description: Part of a field name to look for, ignoring case (status, duration, user); lists only matching fields. null for all.

tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Query a website's backend logs: filters, word search and aggregations (counts, percentiles, time series). Without aggregations it returns lines, newest first; repeat with cursor set to nextCursor for older ones. Count where failures are first, then read a few lines with fields set. Field names from list_log_sources; at most 31 days.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

sourceId.description: Log source id from list_log_sources; needed when the website has several.

query.description: from and to (at most 31 days apart), then filters, search and aggregations, or fields for log lines.

from.description: ISO timestamp with an offset, such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z.

to.description: ISO timestamp with an offset, such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z.

search.description: Whole words to find in any field, ignoring case. Add * for part of a word (time*, *out*). A filter on a known field is faster. null for none.

filters.description: Conditions every returned log line meets.

field.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

op.description: eq and neq match exactly, including case. contains, not_contains and starts_with ignore case. exists and not_exists take no value; in takes a list.

value.description: A list for in, null for exists and not_exists, otherwise one value.

aggregations.description: Empty returns log lines, newest first. Otherwise one row per group, with a column per aggregation named fn or fn_field (count, p95_duration_ms).

field.description: The field to aggregate; null for count.

anyOf.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

items.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

interval.description: Buckets aggregations over _time, one row per bucket and group, oldest bucket first. When buckets times groups pass limit, the oldest buckets are left out. Needs an aggregation. null for none.

fields.description: Fields to return for log lines; all fields when omitted. null when aggregating.

items.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

orderBy.description: Log lines sort by any field (default _time desc); aggregations sort by an output column (default: time, else the first aggregation). null for the default.

field.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

limit.description: Most rows to return; truncated is true when more matched. With an interval, at least one row per time bucket.

cursor.description: Continues log lines from a previous result's nextCursor. Repeat the rest of the query unchanged. null for the first page.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List Slack channels in the organization's connected workspaces, marking the ones Databuddy posts investigations to. Use set_slack_channel to connect or remove one.

search.description: Only channels whose name contains this text.

tools.name: set_slack_channel
tools.description: Connect a Slack channel so Databuddy posts investigations and answers there, or remove it. Removing stops the posts; the app stays in the channel and a mention adds it back. Preview first; apply after the user approves.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID from list_slack_channels, for a channel shared by two connected workspaces.

connected.description: true connects the channel; false removes it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: list_github_repos
tools.description: List GitHub repositories the organization's Databuddy GitHub App can read, with the website each is linked to. Use set_github_repo to link one.

search.description: Only repositories whose owner/name contains this text.

tools.name: set_github_repo
tools.description: Link a website to its GitHub repository so its charts mark deploys and releases, unlink it with repository null, or choose which deployment environments and whether releases show. list_annotations' github lists the environments and current choice. Preview first; apply after the user approves.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

repository.description: owner/name from list_github_repos, or null to unlink. Omit to keep the linked repository.

environments.description: Deployment environments whose deploys show, from list_annotations' github.environments; null shows the production environments matched to the website, or every one when none match. Omit to keep the current choice.

releases.description: Whether charts show the repository's releases. Omit to keep the current choice.

linkedRepository.description: The preview's current repository, passed back when confirming: if the website links another one by then, nothing changes.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

tools.name: get_search_console
tools.description: Google search data for a website from Search Console, read with your own Google account: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position in total and by query, page, country and device, each row with previous for the same-length period just before. page lists the searches that led to one page; query lists the pages one search led to.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

page.description: Only the searches that led to this page: a path such as /pricing, read on the website's host with or without www, or a full URL as Search Console lists it.

query.description: Only the pages this exact search led to.

limit.description: Rows to return in each list, most clicks first.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, or blocking error about Databuddy itself to the Databuddy team. Call only after the user asks or agrees to send it. Problems on the user's own website are analytics questions.

description.description: The user's words plus context: the page or feature, what they expected, and what happened.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.
